vars.description: Your page is missing an H1 tag. This is the first thing AI models look at to understand your page topic.

vars.brand_knowledge: Riverside Dental is a family and cosmetic dental clinic in Manchester, UK. It offers checkups, emergency appointments, and private treatments including Invisalign.
vars.page_content:
Treatments
Invisalign Clear Aligners

Straighten your teeth discreetly with removable clear aligners, fitted by our Manchester team.

How Invisalign works

We take a 3D scan of your teeth and plan each stage of movement before you start.

What it costs

Invisalign at Riverside Dental starts at GBP 2,400, with interest-free payment plans over 12 months.

Book a consultation

Call our Manchester clinic or use the online booking form.
